product_improvements_from_trial: Resolve one exported typed literal Playwright project array without evaluating the configuration module.
Apply static testIgnore rules and device-field overrides to exact project-qualified flows.
Prefer distinct journeys before extra device variants inside the bounded browser floor.
Preserve exact statically asserted HTTP status codes so intentional 4xx behavior is not called a failure.
Assign resources to separate page.goto parents in multi-navigation tests.
Distinguish query variants with a value-free SHA-256 identity instead of merging redacted URLs.
Associate contained Next webpack-internal V8 frames with repository files while retaining the unverified-map limitation.
Accept an explicitly marked Next standalone process only after repository-CWD and declared-family attestation.
Own a config-disabled Next development lifecycle with environment-file rejection, static GET warmup, attestation, and cleanup.
Exclude Next development framework chunks only when that exact runtime configuration is retained in the capture.
limitations: The production-build evidence used an externally prepared clean build; the autonomous runtime is a separate config-disabled development mode.
All timings and memory values are local one-shot observations, not paired optimization evidence or production impact.
The bounded inventory is truncated and does not establish full repository flow coverage.
